title: Lawful Processing Issues
description: The Authentication Service (P1) may process personal data in a way that is not lawful, potentially violating data minimization or consent requirements.

title: Data Type Sensitivity
description: JWT tokens are sensitive personal data. Storing them in localStorage is considered excessive granularity for the authentication flow, as the data is not functionally required for the core authentication process.

title: Data Propagation
description: The JWT is stored in localStorage, which is a local data store. This implies the data is accessible to the browser and potentially other local applications, constituting unnecessary propagation beyond the core authentication flow.

title: Involved Parties
description: The JWT is stored in localStorage, which is a local data store. This implies the data is accessible to the browser and potentially other local applications, constituting unnecessary exposure to external parties beyond the core authentication flow.
